LanguageData.MSS_WFP_Preserve_Desc: Wrap this corpse in herbs. A hauler will bring 3 herbal medicine and spend about 10 minutes preparing it. Once preserved, the corpse will not rot or stink, but yields nothing when butchered.
LanguageData.MSS_WFP_CancelPreserve_Desc: Cancel the pending preservation. Any hauler currently working on this corpse will drop the herbs and stop.
